desc:
A monthly conversion optimization sprint is a focused first month of reviewing your numbers, making improvements and reporting back. Ecom Swift LLC does the work in your own store and explains each change in plain language.

## Why conversion work works best as a steady habit

Store improvement rarely comes from one big change. It comes from a series of small, well chosen changes: a clearer product page, a faster mobile menu, a better cart message, a test of one headline. Each may look minor, but together they make the store easier to buy from.

Most owners know this and still never find the time. Orders, suppliers and customer messages come first, and the store itself stays untouched for months. A fixed sprint puts the work on a schedule and gives it an owner.

## What is a conversion optimization sprint?

A sprint is a short, defined period of work with a clear start and a written result. In this service, the first month covers a review of your key numbers, a set of improvements made in your store, any tests that fit your traffic and a report that says what changed, why and what comes next.

It is a starting point, not a subscription. Many owners continue month by month afterward, and we quote that ongoing care separately once we know what your store needs.

## How steady optimization affects results

Each improvement targets a reason shoppers leave: unclear information, slow pages, weak trust signals or friction in the cart. Fixing one reason lets more of the people already visiting reach the next step. Repeating this across several steps compounds, because each fix gives later fixes more shoppers to work with.

The report matters as much as the changes. When you can see what was changed and what happened to the numbers afterward, you learn what your own shoppers respond to, and your next decision rests on evidence. Outcomes still depend on traffic, product, price and season, so we explain what we saw instead of promising an outcome.

## What a first month sprint includes

- A review of your key numbers: traffic, product views, add to cart, checkout starts and orders.
- A list of the problems that seem to cost the most, in priority order.
- A set of improvements made directly in your store, such as copy, layout and settings changes.
- A review of product pages, with the clearest gaps filled.
- A mobile check, since small screens often hide the biggest problems.
- One or two A/B tests where your traffic is high enough to learn from.
- A review of cart and checkout friction.
- A review of offers and trust items, such as policies and reviews.
- A report with screenshots of the changes.
- A short plan for what to work on next.

## How the month runs

First we look at your analytics and walk through your store as a shopper. From that review we pick the changes most likely to help, and we confirm the list with you before making edits. Changes are made in your own account, usually on a copy of the theme first, and each one is checked on phone and desktop.

If your traffic is high enough, we set up a test for one of the changes so the effect can be measured. At the end of the sprint you receive a report that explains what we did, what we noticed and what we suggest for the following month.

The Basic package covers a review and a first round of improvements with a short report. The Standard package adds more improvements, one A/B test, a mobile check and a product page review. The Premium package covers the most improvements, up to two tests, a cart and checkout review, a look at offers and trust items and a planning call. Add-ons include an extra improvement round, another test or a competitor snapshot.

## What to do, and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Share your goals and any changes you have already planned.
- Let us change one thing at a time on key pages.
- Read the report and ask about anything unclear.
- Keep a note of promotions and ad changes during the month.
- Decide on next steps after the report, not before.

**Avoid:**
- Judging the sprint by one week of sales.
- Making your own edits to the same pages at the same time.
- Running a large sale during a test.
- Expecting a fixed number of extra orders.
- Skipping the report and moving on to something new.

## Who this is for

The sprint suits a store owner who wants steady progress but has no time to plan it, a business that has finished a redesign or audit and needs the fixes carried out, and a seller who wants to see what regular optimization looks like before committing to monthly care.

## What we need from you

We need access to your store and analytics as a collaborator, staff or team user. We never need your passwords. Tell us your main goal and any pages that worry you, and after you order we reply with a short checklist and a plan for the month.
